meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Home:* Private Pool (optional heating available for an additional $75/night)* Less than a mile to deeded beach access* 6 Complimentary Adult Bikes* Partial Gulf Views from the Fourth-Floor Balcony* Snorkel the Grouper Reef – See more i
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Home:* Private Pool (optional heating available for an additional $75/night)* Less than a mile to deeded beach access* 6 Complimentary Adult Bikes* Partial Gulf Views from the Fourth-Floor Balcony* Snorkel the Grouper Reef – See more information under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 ServiceThis property does not allow parties of adults under the age of 25. No Exceptions.We LOVE Snowbirds! Enjoy Special Monthly Winter Rates!Snowbird Season runs November through February. For a quote, select an arrival date on the 1st of the month and a departure date on the 1st of a subsequent month. Contact us for alternate date requests or assistance with your stay. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee.Welcome to The Mermaid, a spacious five-bedroom, four-bath coastal retreat in the desirable Seacrest Beach community along Scenic Highway 30A. Spread across four levels, this inviting home offers the perfect setting for a memorable beach getaway, complete with a private pool, six complimentary adult bikes, an outdoor shower, and partial Gulf views from the fourth-floor balcony. The second-floor living area is designed for gathering, featuring an open-concept layout with a fully equipped kitchen, generous dining space, and a comfortable living room. Whether you're preparing a family meal, enjoying a movie night, or relaxing after a day at the beach, there's plenty of room to spend time together. With five bedrooms thoughtfully spread throughout the home, everyone can find their own space to recharge. The third-floor master suite offers a private balcony for a quiet escape.Spend your mornings biking along 30A, your afternoons lounging beside the private pool, and your evenings exploring nearby coastal communities or enjoying the Gulf views from the fourth-floor balcony. With convenient access to the beach, local dining, shopping, and outdoor adventures, The Mermaid is the perfect home base for experiencing the best of the 30A lifestyle.No Smoking: Smoking and vaping are strictly prohibited inside the home and anywhere on the property, including patios, balconies, decks, and all outdoor areas.The Bed Setup:1st Floor:Guest Bedroom 1: King BedGuest Bedroom 2: Twin-over-Full Bunk BedGuest Bedroom 3: Queen Bed2nd Floor:Guest Bedroom 4: Queen Bed3rd Floor:Master Bedroom: King Bed*Parking: Use designated parking spaces only. Street parking, golf carts, and low-speed vehicles (LSVs) are not permitted.*Quiet Hours: 10 PM–6 AM. Please respect community quiet hours and keep noise to a minimum.*Beach Access: Access the beach through the gated boardwalk at the end of the east side of the street. Beach and boardwalk access codes do not work at the neighboring Elysee or Santimo beach accesses. Beach Rules: The deeded private beach requires chairs and umbrellas to be rented through the designated vendor. Personal umbrellas, tents, and amplified music are not permitted.*Public Beach Access: Inlet Beach Regional Access, 438 S. Orange Street, Inlet Beach.Pets: No pets allowed.The Mermaid is located in the beautiful Seacrest Beach area of Inlet Beach, a sought-after coastal destination known for its laid-back atmosphere and convenient access to the best of 30A. The community features a community pool and a dock providing access to Lake Powell, offering additional opportunities to enjoy the outdoors.Situated just off the eastern end of iconic Scenic Highway 30A, this home places you close to some of the area's most popular destinations. Explore the shops and restaurants at 30Avenue, spend the day at Camp Helen State Park, or venture into nearby Inlet Beach and Alys Beach for beautiful coastal scenery, local dining, and boutique shopping. With beach access, outdoor recreation, and charming beach communities all close by, The Mermaid is an ideal setting for your next Florida getaway.Area Attractions:Serving as the gateway to 30A, 30Avenue is located at the intersection of Highway 98 and east entry of famed Scenic Highway 30A. It is a lifestyle center offering exceptional restaurants, boutique shopping, health and beauty services all within easy walking distance of Inlet, Rosemary, Seacrest and Alys beaches.“The Big Chill” is an incredible spot for dining and entertainment nearby. The Big Chill offers something for folks of all ages and tastes, from tacos and tequila to wings, burgers, and shakes. A stop here is quick, tasty, and convenient, and comes with a side of entertainment at the outdoor amphitheater. It's a great place to catch a concert, sporting event, or a movie on the lawn.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
